I got this FORLONG Ceramic Van Gogh Coffee Mug and Saucer set with Spoon (Starry Night) for my husband who is an artist and teaches art classes at a university. It is really difficult for me to get art gifts for him, because I'm not an artist.
But, I "hit this one out of the ball park!" He loves it and put it on his shelf in his office for display! It is quality made and was packed very well in a nice box that is giftable. I highly recommend it!This cup, saucer, and spoon set is every bit at lovely as in the ad's photo. I ordered it to give to my sister next Christmas. She appreciates artistically crafted items; and as an artist herself, I think she'll like the Starry Night design. I think this cup and saucer are so beautiful that I'm considering buying a different design to give to a friend who is also artistically inclined. My photo shows the cup next to the simple, stackable cup that I normally use for coffee. The two hold identical amounts. This cup is, in my view, just a normal sized cup--neither distinctively small nor distinctively large. It comes well packed in an attractive box. A great gift for those who appreciate the beautiful and the different!Click to play video
What an interesting way for art to inspire art. I saw this and had to have it. When I received it, I found the contents well protected from damage during shipping. The craftsmanship is excellent, and the design is so close to Van Gogh's artwork that it is a tribute to his genius. Handmade and hand-painted, this ceramic cup and saucer are gorgeous. I'm not particularly a collector, but I do like things that are unique from my point of view. I could easily see this being displayed by someone who collects cups. It would be a fresh and unusual addition. I did look at additional offerings from this seller; they are also beautifully created and unique. I am impressed with the quality of this ceramic cup design and believe that the seller's products will be very popular with collectors and those who enjoy unusual items. This would also make a terrific gift. If you enjoy this mug, saucer, and spoon, check out the seller's offerings; you may find something that speaks to you, just as this one does to me.Beautiful cup set. The picture is amazing. I haven't used it as a cup but I use it on my nightstand as a nik nak. I also use the small tray as a ring holder for my wedding band. Wouldn't hurt to use it as a drinking cup but I don't have that purpose in mind for this at all!First seeing this, I thought it looked like a cute, funny , irreverent representation of a van Gogh "Starry Nights" painting.
When I got the actual cup what a surprise it was: delicate, glowing, realistic and beautifully colored.
Highly recommended, as a decoration, a gift, or for a special time to enjoy your favorite beverage.This kit is super cute
